generations.instruction:
Use your built-in image_gen tool (imagegen skill, built-in mode) to generate exactly ONE image from the art spec below. Attached Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE only (the game's current cream dino and its obstacles: green angkot minibus, taro basket, rain puddle), shown upscaled with nearest-neighbour. After generating, copy the generated PNG file from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to ./gen/sheet-01.png in the current directory. Do not write code, do not edit any other files, and do not generate more than one image.

ART SPEC
Use case: stylized-concept / game asset. Asset type: pixel-art sprite sheet for a tiny browser endless-runner, landscape 3:2.
Input images: Image 1 = style reference (match its outline weight, chunky low-res pixel scale, flat cel shading and muted palette).
Background: one flat solid color #edf0df over the whole image. No gradient, no texture, no ground line, no shadows, no text, no labels, no frame borders, no grid lines.
Rendering: strict pixel art. Every art pixel is a crisp square on ONE consistent grid (about 12 screen pixels per art pixel), no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, no dithering noise. A uniform 1-art-pixel dark navy #172d43 outline around every sprite.

ROW 1 (top half): the dinosaur, 6 poses left to right, evenly spaced with wide empty gaps, all facing RIGHT, all at the same scale, all feet resting on one shared invisible baseline:
 1. idle/standing (about 44 art px wide x 47 art px tall)
 2. run A: front leg forward, back leg lifted back
 3. run B: legs swapped
 4. crash: identical to idle but the eye is a small X
 5. duck A: crouched low and long (about 59 art px wide x 25 art px tall): body horizontal, back flat, head pushed forward at the same height as the back, tiny arm, short legs
 6. duck B: identical to duck A with the legs swapped
Character: the friendly cream GDGoC dinosaur from Image 1 - a Chrome offline T-Rex style silhouette: big boxy head with a flat top and long rectangular snout, one small square navy eye, a short navy mouth line, a tiny arm, compact chunky body, short tail pointing back-left, two short stubby legs. Colors: cream #f3e6b8 body, highlight #fff3ce along the top/back edge, shade #e3d099 on the right and under side, navy #172d43 outline, eye and mouth. The upper body must be IDENTICAL in idle, run A, run B and crash, and identical in duck A and duck B; only the legs change.

ROW 2 (bottom half): an Elang Jawa (Javan hawk-eagle, Nisaetus bartelsi) flying LEFT (head and beak on the left side), 2 animation frames side by side with a wide gap: frame 1 wings raised high above the body, frame 2 wings swept down below the body. Same pixel scale (about 46 x 40 art px per frame), same 1-art-pixel navy #172d43 outline and same flat 3-tone shading as the dinosaur. Dark brown back and wings, chestnut/rufous head, a black crest with a white tip sticking up from the back of the head, cream throat, cream belly with brown horizontal bars, yellow hooked beak, yellow feet tucked under the body. Compact and readable at tiny size, body horizontal.

Avoid: extra characters, props, scenery, ground, text, watermark, blurry or painterly pixels, mixed pixel sizes, perspective, 3D, drop shadows, sprites touching each other.
